title.es: Qué tan sensible es el resultado

footer_disclaimer.es: MorrowAge es una estimación de bienestar y riesgo relativo poblacional. No diagnostica, no predice con certeza tu longevidad y no sustituye atención médica.
footer_disclaimer.en: MorrowAge is a population-based wellness and relative-risk estimate. It does not diagnose, predict your lifespan with certainty, or replace medical care.
footer_disclaimer.pt: MorrowAge é uma estimativa populacional de bem-estar e risco relativo. Não diagnostica, não prevê sua longevidade com certeza e não substitui cuidados médicos.

presentation_guardrails.morrow_age: No exact numeric value outside 40–69; render <40 or >69.
presentation_guardrails.delta_age: Hide exact delta when equivalent age is outside source reference range.
presentation_guardrails.sensitivity: Measurement scenario only; never label confidence interval.
presentation_guardrails.action_plan: Educational, non-causal; never derive behavior recommendation from coefficient sign alone.
